module: Crawl integration in multiplayer freeroam. Loaded by gameplay_crawl_general when a multiplayer session starts (onMPSessionChanged), unloaded when it ends. It shows the "scoreboard" app at the top left and creates a scoreboard (multiplayer_multiplayerScoreboard) with a penalty points column (ascending sort). It updates the local player's score, makes their row flash red (penalty) or green (bonus), and indicates disqualification or finish.
notes: No function is callable: the module only exports crawl event hooks.
onCrawlPenaltyScoreChanged expects eventData.penaltyScore and eventData.oldPenaltyScore; a score increase (penalty) gives a red flash, a decrease a green flash.

The scoreboard is identified by trail.id (onCrawlStarted receives the {trail = ...} table from the gameplay_crawl_general hooks, so trail.id is that of this table, not of the trail: possible inconsistency, since the caller passes {trail = trail}).
The scoreboard app is hidden only on disqualification (endCrawlFreeroam); it stays displayed on a normal finish.

onCrawlStarted.desc: Hook called when a crawl starts: shows the scoreboard app, creates a scoreboard and pushes the initial score 0.

trail.desc: Event data; its id field is used as the scoreboard identifier (see notes).

onCrawlPenaltyScoreChanged.desc: Hook called when the penalty score changes: sends the new value to the scoreboard and makes the player's row flash.

onCrawlDisqualified.desc: Hook called on disqualification: "disqualified" status in the scoreboard and hiding of the scoreboard app.

onCrawlResultsShown.desc: Hook called when the results are shown: pushes the final points and the "finishLine" status.
